Summary: God's command after the waters dried: go forth from the ark, with family and every living thing.
Commandment: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee; bring forth every living thing with thee.
Application: Noah did not leave on his own timing: he waited for the spoken command even after the ground was dry. Distinct moment from entering; same merge caveat as the enter row.
Purpose: To repopulate the cleansed earth from the ark's household and creatures, opening the post-flood order (Genesis 8:17; 9:1).
